01 / Lead study

From a concept model
to a guided visit.

Dubai Residence is an independent, AI-assisted visualization study. Its Blender-built model becomes a browser-based experience with places to look, rooms to enter, and a clear route through the home.

Visual exploration / kitchen + dining

From model frame
to material mood.

An unaltered Blender render anchors the composition. A separate AI-assisted study explores a warmer material and lighting direction for the same kitchen and dining view.

What changes: the generated image adds illustrative finishes, planting, lighting, and furniture details. Those generated details are not in the interactive 3D tour, were not measured or client-approved, and this visual was not commissioned.

What the study demonstrates

One story across stills, model, and movement.

The viewer brings together a guided first-person route, room anchors, a two-floor navigation schematic, and a short residence film. These are presentation tools for reviewing a concept with collaborators or prospective buyers.

02 / Interactive presentation

03 / Review context
Navigation, a viewing sequence, and documented visual and browser checks.

Study boundary. This is a fictional, unbuilt residence. Its plan is a navigation schematic, not a measured architectural drawing. The study is not BIM, engineering, construction documentation, or proof of property sales. The public 3D viewer and film played in a browser check on 28 September 2026.

For a defined property brief

A presentation package
with a clear handoff.

A possible engagement can begin with one space or a single presentation sequence. The exact scope depends on the source material, review audience, and agreed acceptance criteria.

What to include in a brief ↗
  1. 01

    Establish the story

    Agree on the space, intended audience, references, and what a viewer needs to understand.

  2. 02

    Build the visual route

    Develop the selected views, model or walkthrough, and a sequence for feedback.

  3. 03

    Deliver reviewable evidence

    Share agreed files and browser checks with known limits and a focused revision pass.

Start with a specific challenge

Have a space to
make tangible?

For a useful first conversation, share the property stage, available plans or reference imagery, who will review the visualization, the desired presentation format, and the deadline.
